text:
alex: Quick sync — scheduling an office hours this Fri 2:00pm PT to align on the new connector API contract for tooling partners (LangChain / LlamaIndex / gateway adapters). Goal: finalize auth/manifest/versioning fields, clarify backward-compat policy, and agree marketplace packaging checklist. Draft spec: https://internal.redwood/specs/connector-api-draft (internal). Agenda in thread below, pls RSVP.

maria: I can attend. Can we add a short demo of the test harness and smoke tests?

sam: yes please. Also flag: current LangChain adapters expect an alias field called `model_alias` — do we standardize on that or use `model_family`? That breaks a few upstream adapters if changed.

lina: SI asks about rollout window and rollback strategy — they'd prefer a 2-week canary + auto-fallback to previous manifest if heartbeat fails. Add to agenda.

devon: Partner Eng will bring a minimal test harness (helm chart + docker-compose) and a tiny adapter shim. Posting quick dev snippet for the harness run so folks can sanity-check locally:

```
# run local harness
git clone git@internal.redwood:partners/connector-harness.git
cd connector-harness
./scripts/run-local.sh --with-langchain-adapter
```

Please tell me which cloud creds we should bake into the demo, or we can use mock creds.

jonathan: Also propose we lock tracing + span tag names (OpenTelemetry) so SIs can correlate traces across gateway <-> Redwood. I'll paste a suggested tag set in the doc.

alex: Great — updated agenda: 1) quick review of spec link 2) compatibility mapping (model_alias vs model_family) 3) canary + rollback pattern for marketplace listings 4) test harness demo & required creds 5) tracing/tagging contract 6) next steps and announcement timing.

maria: Who should I invite from LangChain / LlamaIndex? I can reach out to their PMs/SDK leads if you share names.

sam: CC: @jess-langchain (PM) and @rob-lindex (SDK lead) — both are okay with short notice. I'll ping them after this thread.

devon: Action items before office hours: 1) I'll open PR with harness and a README describing smoke tests (ETA Thu EOD). 2) Sam, can you drop a short compatibility matrix mapping old alias -> new fields? 3) Maria, please send invites to the LangChain/LlamaIndex contacts.

lina: We'll prepare SI runbook snippets for rollback, and add a checklist for infra/security review for marketplace packaging.

alex: Sweet. Meeting link: https://meet.internal.redwood/rooms/connector-office-hours. If anyone can't make Fri 2pm PT, drop availability here. Otherwise I'll post the calendar invite.

partner-bot: Reminder scheduled: Office hours "Connector API contract — partners" on Fri 14:00 PT (organizer: alex).

maria: One more ask — can we pre-seed a small prompt set for the compatibility regression eval? If yes, I'll coordinate with research to add it to the harness.

sam: yep, send me the prompt list; I'll wire it into the smoke tests so we fail the build on obvious regressions.

alex: Awesome. Thanks team — see you Fri.
